info.title: veed/clean-audio
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "veed/clean-audio", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for `POST /proxy/veed/v1/clean-audio`. The job is billed from the credits VEED charges once it completes.

audio_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the recording to clean, up to 30 minutes.

normalize_loudness.description: Set to false to keep the input loudness.

strength.description: How much background noise is removed under speech.

target_lufs.description: Output loudness in LUFS. Ignored when `normalize_loudness` is false.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for VEED Clean Audio: the terminal `GET /proxy/veed/v1/clean-audio/{job_id}` job document, forwarded unchanged. The cleaned audio is at `data.result.audio.url`.

file_size.description: Size of the file in bytes.

url.description: URL the file can be downloaded from.

credits_charged.description: Credits VEED charged for the job. Present once the job is COMPLETED.

credits_estimated.description: Credits VEED quoted before the job ran. Present only on the submit response.

job_id.description: Job id used to poll for status.

status.description: Job status: PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED or CANCELLED.

VeedJobError.description: Failure information. Present once the job has FAILED.

VeedJobResponse.description: A VEED job, wrapped in VEED's `data` envelope.

VeedJobResult.description: The produced media. Present once the job is COMPLETED. Video routes answer `video`, Clean Audio answers `audio` and Video Background Removal answers `files`.

files.description: Video Background Removal output. One WebM with alpha for `vp9`, or the RGB video and an alpha matte for `h264`.
